about: F-MEMORY: synthetic project decisions with sources, paraphrase queries with the expected record (by title) in the top five, and two contradictory notes. Sources are F-CODE paths.

decisions.title: Use PostgreSQL as the primary datastore
decisions.body: Chosen over MongoDB for transactions and mature tooling. SQLite stays for local tests.

decisions.title: Cache rendered pages in Redis for ten minutes
decisions.body: Invalidate on publish. In-process memoization was too small for three servers.

decisions.title: Sign users in with OAuth through the company SSO
decisions.body: No local passwords; sessions expire after eight hours.

decisions.title: Run background jobs from a RabbitMQ queue
decisions.body: Workers acknowledge after success; failed jobs go to a dead-letter queue.

decisions.title: Emit structured JSON logs with request ids
decisions.body: Shipped to the central log store; traces sampled at 10%.

decisions.title: Deploy with blue-green rollouts on Fridays only after noon
Wrap every handler failure in an ApiError with a code
decisions.body: Codes are listed in the API reference.

decisions.title: Settings load from config.toml, then environment variables override them
Keep p95 latency under 200 ms for page loads
Every bug fix ships with a regression test

paraphrases.query: which database do we persist data in?
how is caching of pages handled
what login method do users have
when can we ship a release

contradiction.title: Version the API in the URL path (/v1/...)
Version the API with an Accept header, never in the path
